# KuplyTashkent

> KuplyTashkent (kuplyu-tashkent.uz) buys used household appliances and furniture in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. We visit the seller, inspect the item on site, agree the price, and pay cash on the spot. Working condition only.

Languages: Russian (ru) and Uzbek (uz). Every page exists in both.

## What we buy (working condition)
- Refrigerators and freezers (Samsung, LG, Bosch, Artel, Atlant, Beko, Liebherr, Indesit)
- Washing machines (Samsung, LG, Bosch, Artel, Indesit)
- Televisions, including LED, OLED and QLED, and Smart TV (Samsung, LG, Sony, Artel, Shivaki)
- Air conditioners (Samsung, LG, Gree, Midea, Artel)
- Gas stoves (Artel, Gefest, Gorenje, Bosch, Hansa, Zanussi, Hotpoint-Ariston)
- Monitors
- Furniture: beds, mattresses, sofas, wardrobes, tables and chairs, kitchen furniture
- Carpets and rugs (ковры, палас)

## What we do not buy
- Mobile phones and smartphones
- Laptops, PCs and computer equipment
- Non-working household appliances, or appliances sold for parts (работающие only)

## How selling works
1. Send the model (from the label) and photos by phone or email.
2. A specialist visits and inspects the item on site.
3. The price is agreed, and payment is cash on the spot.
